title: The files of the domains Woodcore writes
description: data/domain-files.json -- the file of each calculation domain Woodcore wrote from its data, by kind and id, from the Typst root (spec 2026-10-21-commandes-typst-refonte, ARCH-008): what `domain-file(kind, id)` reads, so that a section includes a domain by `#include domain-file("check", id)` and never by a path written by hand. Written by the export (calc/domains/unfold.py `domain_files`), whole and sorted; never edited by hand.

schema_version.description: 1.0 -- a file written at another version is refused rather than read as this one.

files.description: {kind: {id: the file from the Typst root}} -- `check` for a member check unfolded.
